value.rationale: The motivating article shows a nonexistence interval and a high-price allzero threshold but leaves intermediate prices unresolved on even the complete graph. A full exact classification, two-per-integer resonance and explicit alternating bids establish precise robustness and equilibrium multiplicity over all prices and every population size in a natural complete-conflict binary-priority market. The result is a natural model-wise theorem rather than a chosen isolated example; extrapolation to richer games is not asserted.
